The '''Cato Neimoidia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].
